Guides / Progress & money / Money

Money

Every way to earn money, with the formulas.

SourcePays
Wild battle (win or catch)level × 3 (Common) / 4 (Uncommon) / 7 (Rare) / 25 (Legendary) × 0.45, ×3 for a special look
…boosted byAmulet Coin +10%/level, each Shiny in the party +15% (up to 3), Luck Incense ×1.25, money events
New species$40 (Common), $80 (Uncommon), $200 (Rare), $1,000 (Legendary)
Pokédex milestonesEvery 10 species: 10 Great Balls + $500. Every 50: +5 Ultra Balls, 5 Rare Candy and $2,500 instead
Bosseslevel × 12
Gyms$1,500 × the Gym's number (first win)
Island checklists$5,000 × the island's number
The Professor$100 (Common) / $150 (Uncommon) for plain ones; otherwise level × 6 × rarity × looks (see the Professor)
Releaselevel × 4 (×10 for a special look)
Selling itemsNugget $1,000, Big Nugget $5,000, balls at half price, held / evolution items at a quarter, Mega Stones $2,000
Research, achievements, Stamp book, raids, TowerSee their pages
FriendsFriends can send you up to $1,000,000 a day in total

Money buys balls, upgrades, items, Power-ups, Move Tutor moves and some Style items. Every trade has a small fee (see Trading).
